goal: Return structured JSON-RPC errors instead of empty HTTP 403 responses when -rpcwhitelist denies calls
Fixes uninformative errors and decoding failures in bitcoin-cli over both HTTP and IPC
agreement: Suggests merging PR #36758 first because this change exposes that bug more widely (pinheadmz)

why: P3 because empty denial responses violate the JSON-RPC 2.0 spec and break IPC clients
Resolves cryptic decoding errors for users and tools calling disallowed methods
